title: localtest-v2 component manifest
description: The single source of truth for the localtest-v2 stack: every container (image, ports, environment, mounts, dependencies, health, group, front-door routes), the optional component groups, the image pin, the shared Postgres and the test certificate. studioctl embeds this file (internal/localtestv2/manifest) and builds its containers and its front door's route table from it. Strings in environment values, commands, container health checks and route hosts may hold {{placeholders}}; see README.md beside this file for the vocabulary.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Relative path of this schema, for editors.

version.title: Format version
version.description: The manifest format version. A loader refuses a version it does not know.

containerPrefix.title: Container name prefix
containerPrefix.description: Prepended to a component's name to form its container name (localtest-v2-storage). `studioctl env logs -c <name>` accepts either form.

network.title: Container network
network.description: The bridge network every container joins. Containers find Postgres and Redis on it by their network aliases; everything else they reach through the public origin on the host.

certificate.title: Shared test certificate
certificate.description: The test key pair every app and component signs platform access tokens with and validates them against (localtest/certs). The runtime writes it to a host directory and mounts it read-only.

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: The certificate's file name, the same on the host and in the containers.

containerDir.title: Container directory
containerDir.description: Where a mount of kind certificateDir puts the host directory. {{certPath}} is this directory plus fileName.

images.title: Images
images.description: Where the components' images come from. A component names its image by one of three sources: research (built by this repository's image workflow and pinned by tag), thirdParty (a pinned external image) or core (an image studioctl's localtest runtime runs too).

repositoryPrefix.title: Research repository prefix
repositoryPrefix.description: A research image's repository is this prefix plus its name (ghcr.io/ivarne-agent/localtest-research/localtest-storage).

tag.title: Pinned tag
tag.description: The tag every research image runs: sha-<commit> of the build studioctl was tested with, bumped by hand after a run against that build. `env up --latest` and tagEnv replace it.

tagEnv.title: Tag override variable
tagEnv.description: studioctl's environment variable that runs every research image at another tag ("latest" follows main and is re-pulled on every start).

overrideEnvPrefix.title: Per-image override variable prefix
overrideEnvPrefix.description: studioctl's per-image override for a research or third-party image is this prefix plus the image name upper-cased with - turned into _ (STUDIOCTL_IMAGE_LOCALTEST_V2_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT); it holds a complete reference (repository:tag) and stops the image from following a tag.

thirdParty.title: Third-party images
thirdParty.description: Pinned external images by name. Their tag is not the research build's: --latest and tagEnv leave them alone.

core.title: Core images
core.description: Images studioctl's localtest runtime runs too, by name. studioctl takes them from its own image configuration (internal/config/images.go, CoreImages), where they follow what tt02 runs; this section mirrors that configuration for other readers, and a studioctl test keeps the mirror right.

volumes.title: Named volumes
volumes.description: Every named volume the components mount. They outlive `env down`; `env reset` deletes all of them.

name.title: Name
name.description: The volume's name in the container runtime.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the volume holds and which image user owns it.

postgres.title: Shared Postgres
postgres.description: The one Postgres server, with a database per component.

component.title: Component
component.description: The component that is the Postgres server.

user.title: Superuser
user.description: The superuser name ({{postgresUser}}). A fixed local test value.

password.title: Superuser password
password.description: The superuser password ({{postgresPassword}}). A fixed local test value, not a secret.

initScripts.title: Init scripts
initScripts.description: The files baked into the Postgres image (localtest/postgres/Dockerfile): the scripts under /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d run on an empty data volume only, in name order, each creating its component's database and users idempotently. studioctl does not read this list (the image carries the files); it is here for runtimes that start a stock Postgres, and a studioctl test checks it against the Dockerfile.

items.title: Init file
items.description: One file copied into the image.

source.title: Source
source.description: The file, relative to the localtest/ folder of the research repository.

frontDoor.title: Front door
frontDoor.description: What the front door (studioctl-server on the host, serving http://local.altinn.cloud:8000) needs beyond the components' own routes.

healthPath.title: Front-door health path
healthPath.description: Polled on the public origin after the components answer, which proves the front door forwards (it reaches the localtest app).

hostRoutes.title: Routes to the host
hostRoutes.description: Routes to processes on the developer's machine rather than to a container.

items.title: Host route
items.description: One route to a loopback port on the host.

name.title: Name
name.description: The route's component name in the route table.

host.title: Host
host.description: The public host name; may hold placeholders.

hostPort.title: Host port
hostPort.description: The loopback port the route forwards to.

app.title: App environment
app.description: The environment an app runs with against this stack, which every runner sets: studioctl's `run` and `app env` (internal/cmd/app/env.go) and the Aspire package's AddAltinnApp. The runner adds what only it knows: the Kestrel URL, the frontend asset base URL, the OpenTelemetry endpoint, the data-protection keys directory and the secrets directory's path. A variable appears in one section only.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Set on every run unless the environment the app inherits (studioctl's shell) already has the variable. Values may hold the topology placeholders ({{platform}}, {{url:...}}, {{host:...}}) and {{certFileName}}; single braces ({org}, {app}) are the app's own and pass through unchanged.

fixedEnvironment.title: Fixed environment
fixedEnvironment.description: Set on every run whatever the inherited environment holds: the contract is the runner's to state, not the shell's.

accessTokenSigning.title: Access token signing
accessTokenSigning.description: The certificate the app signs its platform access tokens with, set like environment when the runner has the shared certificate (studioctl: while localtest-v2 is up; the Aspire package: always). Values may also hold the runner's {{appCertPath}} and {{appCertKeysFolder}}, which only this section may use.

secrets.title: Secrets directory
secrets.description: The app's secrets directory and the files in it, named as the platform names them for a deployed app (the operator's configuration map). Every variable here is fixed. The runner sets directoryEnv to the directory it creates.

directoryEnv.title: Directory variable
directoryEnv.description: The variable holding the secrets directory's path.

files.title: Files
files.description: The files the app reads from the directory.

items.title: Secrets file
items.description: One file of the secrets directory and the variable that names it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The file's name in this manifest, for the runners' code.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the file holds and who writes it.

env.title: Variable
env.description: The variable that names the file; its value is fileName.

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: The file's name in the secrets directory.

writtenOnEveryRun.title: Written on every run
writtenOnEveryRun.description: Every runner writes the file before the app starts, with the same bytes. Otherwise the developer stores it (studioctl app maskinporten set).

groups.title: Optional component groups
groups.description: `env up --with <group>` enables a group and, transitively, the groups it implies; `--without <group>` leaves out only the named group, and leaving out a group an enabled group implies is an error. A component with a group exists only while its group is enabled; its routes are written either way, disabled while the group is off, so the front door answers 503 with the command that starts it.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the group runs and why it is optional.

onByDefault.title: On by default
onByDefault.description: Whether `env up` enables the group when no flag names it.

implies.title: Implied groups
implies.description: The groups that start with this one because its components cannot run without them.

impliesAll.title: Implies every group
impliesAll.description: The group implies every other group (everything).

components.title: Components
components.description: Every container: the always-on ones and those of the groups. The list order is the order of `env status`, `env logs` and the health wait; the runtime starts each component after its dependsOn, wherever they are in the list.

appVariables.title: App variables
appVariables.description: Environment variables by name, with placeholders in the values.

additionalProperties.title: Value
additionalProperties.description: The variable's value, with placeholders resolved by the runner.

name.title: Name
name.description: A lower-case name: letters, digits and dashes.

prefix.title: Path prefix
prefix.description: The path prefix the route matches on its host; empty matches the whole host. The longest matching prefix wins.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: A Go duration such as 2s or 500ms.

externalImage.title: External image
externalImage.description: An image that is not one of the research builds.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the image is and why this tag.

floating.title: Floating
floating.description: The tag moves as new builds are published, so the image is re-pulled on every start (keeping the local copy when the registry is unreachable).

overrideEnv.title: Override variable
overrideEnv.description: studioctl's environment variable that replaces the reference, when it is not the rule-derived one.

name.title: Name
name.description: The component's name: the container is containerPrefix plus it, `env logs -c` and the route table use it, and other components' dependsOn and placeholders refer to it.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the component is, in a sentence or two.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Why a setting is what it is. Loaders ignore them.

group.title: Group
group.description: The optional group the component belongs to; absent for the always-on components.

image.title: Image
image.description: Where the image comes from: exactly one of research, thirdParty or core.

research.title: Research image
research.description: The image name under images.repositoryPrefix, at images.tag.

dev.title: Dev build
dev.description: How `env up --dev <selector>` builds the image from the research checkout instead of pulling it; absent when the image is not built from it (core and third-party images). The built image is tagged containerPrefix + name + :dev.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: The --dev name that selects this build; defaults to the component's name. Components built from one folder share a selector (dialogporten builds its three hosts).

context.title: Build context
context.description: The build context, relative to the localtest/ folder (STUDIOCTL_LOCALTEST_V2_SRC).

dockerfile.title: Dockerfile
dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile, relative to the build context; defaults to Dockerfile.

containerPort.title: Container port
containerPort.description: The port the service listens on inside the container ({{port:<name>}}).

hostPort.title: Host port
hostPort.description: The port published on 127.0.0.1, which the front door forwards to and the health wait polls; absent for a container only others on the network reach (Postgres, Redis).

healthPath.title: Health path
healthPath.description: Polled over HTTP on the host port until it answers 200, after the containers run; absent skips the poll.

containerHealthCheck.title: Container health check
containerHealthCheck.description: A health check the container runtime runs inside the container. The runtime waits for it before starting what depends on the component.

test.title: Test
test.description: The check, in the runtime's form: ["CMD", ...] or ["CMD-SHELL", "<command>"]. May hold placeholders.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Consecutive failures before the container counts as unhealthy.

startPeriod.title: Start period
startPeriod.description: Time after start during which failures do not count; absent is none.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: The container's environment. Values may hold placeholders; single braces ({0}, {Org}) are the components' own and pass through unchanged.

additionalProperties.title: Value
additionalProperties.description: The variable's value, with placeholders resolved by the loader.

command.title: Command
command.description: Replaces the image's command. May hold placeholders.

mounts.title: Mounts
mounts.description: What the container mounts. Binds are read-only.

dependsOn.title: Dependencies
dependsOn.description: Components that must be running (and healthy, when they have a container health check) before this one starts. They set the start order; Parse refuses a cycle.

networkAliases.title: Network aliases
networkAliases.description: Names other containers reach this one by on the network ({{alias:<name>}} is the first).

ingressHosts.title: Map the ingress hosts
ingressHosts.description: Whether every public host name (local.altinn.cloud, pdf., workflow-engine., app-frontend., af. and the rest of the topology's ingress hosts) resolves to the host gateway in the container, so it reaches the front door. Defaults to true; false for containers that call nothing (Postgres, Redis).

extraHostGatewayNames.title: More host-gateway names
extraHostGatewayNames.description: Further names mapped to the host gateway (host.docker.internal for Events' webhooks to the developer's machine).

hostUser.title: Run as the developer
hostUser.description: Run as the developer's user (and user namespace) instead of the image's own user. Defaults to false; no component needs it today.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Public host-and-prefix routes the front door forwards to the host port. They are written whether or not the group is on.

host.title: Host
host.description: The public host name, normally {{host:app}}; may hold placeholders.

rewrite.title: Rewrite
rewrite.description: The path forwarded in place of the matched prefix, the rest of the path kept, for a component that serves itself under another path than the public one; absent passes the path unchanged.

oneOf.title: Certificate directory
oneOf.description: The host directory holding the shared certificate, read-only at certificate.containerDir.

oneOf.title: Certificate file
oneOf.description: The shared certificate file alone, read-only at a path of its own (for components that read a default path).

target.title: Target
target.description: The file's path in the container.

oneOf.title: Named volume
oneOf.description: A named volume from the volumes list, read-write.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: A name from the volumes list.

target.title: Target
target.description: The mount point in the container.
